slippers noun

classical

soccus, soccī m.

noun, second declension

slipper or light shoe

The plural soccī is “slippers”.

Other words

  • ūdō, ūdōnis m. — a felt sock or slipper

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Mart. 14.140 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 118

Examples

  • pār soccōrum

    a pair of slippersTraupman 113, 118

  • In vestibulō avus calceōs exuentibus «Ecce,» inquit, «soccī vestrī,» et utrīque pār suum dedit.

    In the hall, as they took off their shoes, Grandpa said, “Here are your slippers,” and gave each of them a pair.composed

See also shoe.
